input.prompt: Animate the first frame exactly: same framing, composition, lighting, setting and character. A solo wushu changquan performer shows the second international compulsory long-fist routine, crisp, fast and powerful, then sharp stops. About 1.7 seconds in she whips a horizontal coiling elbow strike across her chest (gongbu pan zhou). About 2.6 seconds in she snaps a low front kick with her toes pointed while one fist presses down (tantui ya quan). About 3.5 seconds in she steps through and swings a straight leg up to head height, slapping the instep with the same-side hand (dan paijiao, single slap kick). About 4.3 seconds in she lands and shuffles forward one small step. About 5.2 seconds in she stands on one straight leg with the other knee raised high above her hip and throws a horizontal punch to the side (dianbu tixi heng quan), and holds that balance dead still to the end. Each named move lands exactly on a beat of the reference audio. One performer only, the same woman from start to end: two arms, two legs, one head; no limb appears, vanishes, doubles or detaches; nobody else ever appears. Real weight and momentum: knees bend on every landing, the planted foot never slides, sneakers stay on the water between steps. She stays inside the centre of the frame, travelling at most a step or two. The camera is LOCKED OFF on a tripod: no pan, no zoom, no push, no reframing, the horizon stays level. Her mouth stays closed. Same face and eyes as the first frame; she keeps her high ponytail, her orange bands and the round white '1420 MHz' patch on her LEFT upper arm. One continuous shot at real speed, no slow motion, no cuts. No captions, no text.
